svg.title: Daily GPP, TER and NEE from 14 days before to 28 days after a silage harvest at Anttila (n = 4), Särkisuo (n = 3), Qvidja (n = 10) and Viikki (n = 3), in percent of the mean GPP of the 14 days before the harvest; mean and ± 1 SD over the episodes.
svg.desc: Four panels side by side, one per site, with the same axes. X axis: days from the first day of the harvest (−14 to +28, local days, UTC+2). Y axis: GPP, TER and NEE in percent of the mean GPP of the days −14 to −1 before the harvest, from −125 to 225 % (NEE in percent of the GPP before: NEE < 0 = uptake, NEE % = TER % − GPP %). Lines: GPP light blue solid with circles, TER light pink dashed with squares, NEE steel blue dash-dotted with triangles; markers every 7 days. The band around each line is the mean ± 1 SD over the episodes; line and band are drawn only where 2 or more episodes have a value. An orange vertical line marks day 0 (the first day of the harvest), thin lines mark 100 % and 0, a dotted grey line marks 80 % (the recovery level). Anttila (n = 4; 3 to 4 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −44 % (SD 31, n 4), ΔTER 0 % (SD 8, n 4), ΔNEE 44 % (SD 30, n 4). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14: GPP 56 %, TER 54 %, NEE −2 %; days +15 to +28: GPP 74 %, TER 53 %, NEE −21 %. Särkisuo (n = 3; 3 to 3 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −58 % (SD 19, n 3), ΔTER −3 % (SD 14, n 3), ΔNEE 56 % (SD 5, n 3). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14: GPP 42 %, TER 62 %, NEE 20 %; days +15 to +28: GPP 78 %, TER 47 %, NEE −31 %. Qvidja (n = 10; 10 to 10 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −48 % (SD 18, n 10), ΔTER 3 % (SD 31, n 10), ΔNEE 51 % (SD 33, n 10). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14: GPP 52 %, TER 61 %, NEE 9 %; days +15 to +28: GPP 66 %, TER 66 %, NEE 0 %. Viikki (n = 3; 3 to 3 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −44 % (SD 45, n 3), ΔTER −21 % (SD 30, n 3), ΔNEE 23 % (SD 19, n 3). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14: GPP 54 %, TER 52 %, NEE −1 %; days +15 to +28: GPP 82 %, TER 67 %, NEE −15 %.
